cnc_encounter_flag_first.conversion: Mixin @Inject at HEAD (cancellable) of each of the 26 *AdvanceprocProcedure.execute(Event, LevelAccessor, DDD, Entity) (private static on 1.21.1; one mixin per class, from the jar's census): the player's PlayerVariables attachment is read once, only when it exists (hasData, then getData: no default attachment is made); when the handler's encountered_<animal> flag is already true the handler returns (one profiler getEntities, as its search counts); the four advancement handlers run the original when their advancement is not loaded (its look-up then throws). PlayerSquonkCryEffectProcedure: living / client level / Sobbing tested before its search. Exact on 1.21.1 (an ItemStack gathers no capabilities there, so the skipped head item has no side effect). Runtime flag cncEncounterFlagFirst. Helper bons.furious.patch.cnc_coo49.CncScans.
